title: Our Story
intro: Epiloges Fashion Boutique was founded on a simple idea: clothes built to be altered, not replaced.

sections.heading: Considered by Design
sections.body: Every piece starts with the fabric — natural fibres sourced from mills we've worked with for over a decade. We design in small batches, favouring longevity over trend cycles.

sections.heading: Made to Last
sections.body: Our ateliers build with a hand-finished seam and a hem left generous enough to let out — construction more common in bespoke tailoring than mass production. It costs more to make. It shows.

sections.heading: A Quieter Kind of Luxury
sections.body: No logos, no seasons that expire. Just clothes we'd wear ourselves, made the way we'd want them made.
